ai_studio_preset_prompt.AIGE_Background: [LOCKED USER INTENT — DO NOT RE-CLASSIFY] The user has explicitly selected the "Create Virtual Background" entry in the AI Studio UI before sending this message. Your ONLY allowed task for this turn is to create an AIGE virtual background scene image via the canvas skill. You MUST treat this intent as final. Do NOT re-interpret the request as a special effect, prop, sticker, beauty filter, or makeup look, even if the user's prompt contains words such as "effect", "filter", "sticker", "makeup", "lipstick", "eyeshadow", "look", or any other category keyword. Any visual element the user mentions (lighting, glow, mood, color palette, characters, on-screen objects, theme, "with a makeup-style vibe", etc.) is purely a description of the background scene to render — it is NEVER a separate effect/sticker/makeup request and must be baked into the generated background image. You MUST use the canvas skill to produce the result.
ai_studio_preset_prompt.AIGE_Effect: [LOCKED USER INTENT — DO NOT RE-CLASSIFY] The user has explicitly selected the "Create Special Effect" entry in the AI Studio UI before sending this message. Your ONLY allowed task for this turn is to create an AIGE special-effect prop (LSEffect: stickers, AR props, on-screen overlays, interactive on-screen effects, transitions) via the canvas skill. You MUST treat this intent as final. Do NOT re-interpret the request as a virtual background, beauty filter, or makeup look, even if the user's prompt contains words such as "background", "scene", "makeup", "beauty", "filter", "lipstick", or any other category keyword. Any description the user gives (sparkly, glowing, animated, themed background colors behind the prop, makeup-style accents on the asset, etc.) is purely styling instructions for the effect/prop asset to generate — it is NEVER a separate background or makeup request. Note: effects/props are visual assets that sit ON TOP of the camera feed; they are NOT applied to the user's real face as makeup, and they are NOT the camera background image. You MUST use the canvas skill to produce the result.
ai_studio_preset_prompt.AIGE_Makeup: [LOCKED USER INTENT — DO NOT RE-CLASSIFY] The user has explicitly selected the "Create Beauty Filter / Makeup & Styling" entry in the AI Studio UI before sending this message. Your ONLY allowed task for this turn is to create an AIGE beauty / makeup / styling look (eye makeup, eyeshadow, eyeliner, lashes, lipstick, blush, contour, brows, skin tone, hairstyle/hair color look, overall facial styling) via the canvas skill. You MUST treat this intent as final. Do NOT re-interpret the request as a special effect, sticker, prop, or virtual background, even if the user's prompt contains words such as "effect", "sticker", "prop", "background", "scene", or any other category keyword. Rule of thumb: anything that visually decorates or transforms the user's own face, skin, eyes, lips, brows, lashes, or hair belongs to Makeup. For example, "Create a sparkly starry eye effect" describes an eye-makeup look (sparkly starry eyeshadow) and MUST be produced as Makeup — it is NOT a Special Effect prop. You MUST use the canvas skill to produce the result.

aisdk_vlm_prompts.Arena of Valor:
["You analyze the provided sampled frames from Arena of Valor.
Goal: detect only reportable streamer-attributable highlights.
Use visible frames only: OCR, kill feed, center banners, result UI, tower/base UI, health bars, hero actions. Do not use audio.

Core trigger rule:
Set an event boolean true only if this clip should be reported as a highlight. If evidence is weak, off-screen, ally-caused, team-only, or not clearly caused by the streamer hero, keep every event false and score 0-2.

Event rules:
- kill: streamer hero clearly secures or directly causes a confirmed enemy hero kill.
- victory, defeat: final result UI is visible and streamer relevance is meaningful.
- death: streamer death is visible only if it is a reportable dramatic moment.
- double_kill, triple_kill: official banner or kill feed confirms streamer hero multikill.
- low_hp_escape_then_turn: streamer is low HP, survives, then quickly gets kill/payoff.
- tower_dive_outplay: streamer dives/fights under tower, survives, and gains clear kill/objective payoff.

Caption: one short English sentence.
Score: 0-2 none; 3-5 kill/result/death if reportable; 6-8 double/triple/low HP/tower dive; 9-10 multiple strong streamer events.
Return JSON only:
{
  "kill": false,
  "victory": false,
  "death": false,
  "defeat": false,
  "double_kill": false,
  "triple_kill": false,
  "low_hp_escape_then_turn": false,
  "tower_dive_outplay": false,
  "caption": "short English description",
  "score": 0.0
}"]

Goal: detect only reportable player-hero-attributable highlights.
Use visible frames only: kill feed, banners, hero death, HP bars, minimap/HUD, scoreboard, Ancient/result UI, and player hero action. Do not use audio.

Core trigger rule:
Set an event boolean true only if this clip should be reported as a highlight. If it is routine farming, laning, spell casting, general teamfight chaos, ally kill, off-screen, or unclear attribution, keep every event false and score 0-2.

Event rules:
- player_victory: true only when the sampled frames establish both the streamer/player-controlled side (Radiant or Dire) and the final winning side, and the two sides match. - hero_kill: player hero clearly secures or directly participates in a confirmed enemy hero kill.

- low_hp_escape_then_turn: player hero is critically low, survives, then quickly secures a return kill/payoff.
